rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best without spending bytes on a new head or a wider shape. The change keeps the proven forward tail recurrence for most of training, then flips the recurrent-tail traversal to last-block-first after 72% of the train budget so the endgame and exact final eval both optimize the deepest block first. This is a compile-stable traversal-order transplant inspired by the underexplored traversal category: it changes only the late recurrence order, preserves the existing quant-aware/export path, and stays under the 1500-line limit.
title: Late Reverse Tail Recurrence Switch
